detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Ballatory is a short incremental idler where you build and upgrade a chaotic swarm of bouncing balls to destroy cores and earn crazy amounts of money.

BUY, UPGRADE, AND PAINT THE BALLS

PRESTIGE AND COMPLETE SKILLS TO GET PERMANENTLY STRONGER

GROW THE ULTIMATE BALLS

FEATURES

  • Balls

  • Ball paints with unique effects

  • Prestige system with Multipliers, Exponents, and Skill Points

  • 70+ unique skills

  • Boss fights

  • Many cool supporting systems to help with progress

  • Windowed mode with Always On Top toggle
